newsitem.title: CHINA: USX-U.S Steel to invest $30 mln in China iron mine.
newsitem.headline: USX-U.S Steel to invest $30 mln in China iron mine.

text.p: The USX-U.S. Steel Group is to invest $30 million in a venture with a Chinese firem to mine for iron ore in southwestern China, the Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.
The project between U.S. Steel and the Kunming Iron and Steel Corp is expected to yield two million tonnes of iron ore a year with an average grade of 60 percent, Xinhua said.

U.S. Steel will invest $30 million in the first phase of the project with the two sides to make joint investments once prospective reserves are assured, according to an agreement signed on Saturday in the southwestern city of Kunming.
Total investment is expected to reach $200 million, Xinhua said.
The Dahongshan iron mine, 210 km from the Kunmin steelworks, has proven reserves of at least 450 million tonnes of iron ore, Xinhua said.
The new supplies of iron ore will help the steel corporation to raise annual output to 2.5 million tonnes from the current 1.5 million tonnes, Xinhua said.
